mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1600 units signals increased consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence indices
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 1600, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in accommodation periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Interactions between rising employment (PAYEMS) and falling unemployment (UNRATE) signal a tightening labor market, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to impending wage inflation.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 signals reduced economic output, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.025 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: positive trend in real disposable income (RSAFS) drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to increased consumer spending.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between RSAFS and retail sales
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Interaction between rising CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) and stable federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a potential monetary policy mistake, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 58% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.015 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Threshold-triggered: an unemployment rate (UNRATE) drop below 3.0% signals a strong labor market, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 50% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Regime-conditional: in a late-cycle expansion regime, a GDP growth rate (GDPC1) above 4.5% signals overheating, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances in late-cycle expansion regimes, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.
